meta.name: creating-ansible-playbooks
meta.description:
Execute use when you need to work with Ansible automation.
This skill provides Ansible playbook creation with comprehensive guidance and automation.
Trigger with phrases like "create Ansible playbook", "automate with Ansible",
or "configure with Ansible".

copy.tagline: 自动生成可重复使用的服务器运维脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要为多台服务器编写一致的配置和部署步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Generate reusable automation scripts for server operations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to define consistent configuration and deployment steps across many servers.

howto.what: 装上后，当你需要管理多台服务器时，Claude会生成Ansible自动化脚本（playbook）、角色和清单，用于安装软件、配置服务、部署应用，并输出模板、变量等配置文件。
howto.when: 当你说“create Ansible playbook”、“automate with Ansible”等触发语，或提出用Ansible配置服务器时触发。

say.note: Claude会生成含任务、变量和模板的playbook。
Claude会生成角色目录和配置文件。

say.text: 写个playbook加固所有服务器的SSH，禁用root登录。
say.note: Claude会生成带任务、处理器的playbook。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you need to manage multiple servers, Claude will generate Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventories to install software, configure services, and deploy applications, along with templates and variable files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create Ansible playbook", "automate with Ansible", or ask to configure servers with Ansible.

say_en.text: Create an Ansible playbook to install Nginx on Ubuntu and open 80/443.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a playbook with tasks, variables, and templates.

say_en.text: Use Ansible to deploy a Flask app with Gunicorn and systemd services.
say_en.note: Claude will generate role directories and config files.

say_en.text: Write a playbook to harden SSH on all servers, disable root login.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a playbook with tasks and handlers.
